name: Sometani Otoha
source:
A third-year student at Seishin Academy and a member of the news club. She has no sense of justice or understands the spirit of journalism, and is rather selfish. She set her sights on [url=/c133970]Tanaka[/url] in an attempt to get a scoop on him for her own success.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/saiminseishidou/character_page010.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
A third-year student at Seishin Academy and a member of the news club. She has no sense of justice or understands the spirit of journalism, and is rather selfish. She set her sights on [url=/c133970]Tanaka[/url] in an attempt to get a scoop on him for her own success.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/saiminseishidou/character_page010.html]official site[/url]]
